text: Download BrochureBook UnitChoose your residence360 ViewGalleryDa Vinci Tower, Interiors by Pagani Dubai | United Arab EmiratesDa Vinci Tower is the world's first residences by Pagani, a branded residential tower in Downtown Dubai, developed by DarGlobal with interiors crafted by Pagani Automobili. An architectural marvel designed to captivate, its striking façade is balanced on a one-of-a-kind geometric structure that creates a dynamic visual effect commanding attention. At its heart lies the pearl, a suspended sphere that adds a touch of wonder to this masterpiece. Rising 19 floors above the Dubai Canal, with three basement levels and a grand ground floor, the tower offers an unmatched view of the iconic Burj Khalifa and sits just moments from Marasi Business Bay. Its 2, 3 and 4-bedroom residences range from 77 to 398 sq m, with opulent interiors by Pagani that embody the meticulous artistry and innovation inspired by Leonardo da Vinci himself. This landmark Pagani residence is a tribute to the timeless genius that shaped both Pagani's vision and these extraordinary homes.
